summary: Two nearby convenience stores face different rules because only one parcel is coming inside the city.
realLife: At the May hearing Tom Mendenhall described rival stores on either side as Columbia considered a temporary exception for newly annexed properties near outside retailers.
inGame: The catalog supports city action on bottle deposits. needs: annexation boundary and competing outlet distance.

turns.what: The shop owner asks when to start changing shelf notices.
turns.pulledBy: The annexing property meets the waiver terms.
turns.writesBack: The store records when its temporary exception ends.

turns.what: A distributor checks the address before quoting the store a price.
turns.pulledBy: An outside competitor fails the distance test.
turns.writesBack: The applicant remains subject to the usual deposit rule.
